input.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/mp3_tagged && for f in *.mp3; do
  if [ "$(file -b --mime-type "$f")" != "audio/mpeg" ]; then
    echo "SKIP (not audio): $f"
    continue
  fi
  base="${f%.mp3}"
  artist="${base% - *}"
  title="${base#* - }"
  echo "Tagging: artist='$artist' title='$title'"
  ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i "$f" -map 0 -c copy \
    -metadata artist="$artist" \
    -metadata title="$title" \
    -id3v2_version 3 -write_id3v1 1 \
    "/tmp/mp3_tagged/$f" && mv "/tmp/mp3_tagged/$f" "$f"
done
echo "--- Done ---"
